[[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Kren Blista-Vanee/Legends|Kren Blista-Vanee]] maintained a lavish '''reception hall''' on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where he once held a gala for Imperial Center's elite society to commemorate that season's opening-night performance of ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'', a [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] opera. The reception hall was adorned with Blista-Vanee's art collection and 30-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Window/Legends|windows]], which served as walls, offering an amazing view of the Coruscant skyline.
